question: Accenture on-campus ASE / Advanced ASE / AEH round 3 (coding and technical tasks). Three questions were reported: **SQL**, a basic two-table JOIN; **coding**, replace every run of repeating characters with a single `#` while keeping single characters unchanged (for example `aaaaabcccccd` becomes `#b#d`); and **HTML, CSS and JavaScript**: **debug and correct an existing carousel (sliding window) written in JavaScript and add animations using CSS.** This item is the carousel task.
lookingFor: Debugging JavaScript logic: index handling, wrap-around and event handling.
DOM manipulation and class toggling to move slides.
CSS transitions or animations for a smooth slide.
Reading and minimally fixing existing code.
Verifying behaviour at edge positions (first and last slide).
followUps: Why is transform preferred over changing left or margin for animation?
How would you add auto-play and pause on hover?
How would you make the carousel accessible (keyboard and screen readers)?
How would you support swipe gestures on touch devices?
